Geometric/harmonic means

  • See: http://economistatlarge.com/r-guide/arithmetic-harmonic-geometric-means-r

mean.default <- function(x, trim = 0, na.rm = FALSE, type = c(“arithmetic”, “geometric”, “harmonic”), …) { type <- match.arg(type) if (!is.numeric(x) && !is.complex(x) && !is.logical(x)) { warning(“argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA”) return(NA_real_) } if (na.rm) x <- x[!is.na(x)] if (!is.numeric(trim) || length(trim) != 1L) stop(“‘trim’ must be numeric of length one”) n <- length(x) if (trim > 0 && n) { if (is.complex(x)) stop(“trimmed means are not defined for complex data”) if (anyNA(x)) return(NA_real_) if (trim >= 0.5) return(stats::median(x, na.rm = FALSE)) lo <- floor(n * trim) + 1 hi <- n + 1 - lo x <- sort.int(x, partial = unique(c(lo, hi)))[lo:hi] } if (type == “arithmetic”) { .Internal(mean(x)) } else if (type == “geometric”) { prod(x)^(1/n) } else if (type == “harmonic”) { n/sum(1/x) } }

  • See also:

geom_mean <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE, zero.propagate = FALSE) { if (any(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) { return(NaN) } if (zero.propagate) { if (any(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) { return(0) } exp(mean(log(x), na.rm = na.rm)) } else { exp(sum(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm = na.rm)/length(x)) } }

Scale a matrix globally (not by column)

(note: cannot be scale.matrix because scale.default does not have ‘bycol’ argument

scale.mat <- function(mat, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE, bycol = FALSE) { if (bycol) { scale(mat, center = center, scale = scale) } else { matrix(scale(as.vector(mat), center = center, scale = scale), nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat)) } }

(mm <- matrix(1:20, nrow = 4)) scale.mat(mm) scale.mat(mm, bycol = TRUE)
